decision_conditions:
Your property falls within a Flood Zone and/or in an area where there is evidence of a risk from other sources of flooding, including surface water, ground water and sewer flooding therefore a Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) is required for your application.

Please mark the relevant box from the link below and submit.
http://webarchive.nationalarchives.gov.uk/20140328084622/http://www.environment-agency.gov.uk/static/documents/Utility/Advisory_Comments_FZ2-3_v3.1.pdf
description: Extension and reconfiguration of the existing mansard roof through the removal of the rear terrace and replacement of the current dormer with a larger dormer aligned with the main rear façade. The proposal includes slate tile cladding to the dormer, new steel/aluminium bifolding door with metal guarding, a discreet flat rooflight, and associated adjustments to the parapet, drainage, and rear brick wall to create a coherent and contextually appropriate roof extension.
